name: @activepieces/piece-sofya
description: Web tools for AI agents: search the web, fetch pages as clean markdown, extract structured data with AI, and run deep multi-source research.

auth.description:
Follow these steps to obtain your Sofya API Key:

1. Visit [Sofya](https://sofya.co) and create an account (sign up with GitHub for 1,000 free credits per month on most accounts).
2. Open your [dashboard](https://sofya.co/dashboard).
3. Copy your API key (it starts with `ay_live_`).

search.name: search
search.description: Search the web and get full page content, not just snippets.

search_depth.description: "basic" fetches pages and returns extracted content (3 credits). "snippets" returns SERP snippets only, without fetching pages (1 credit).

topic.description: Use "news" for current events, breaking news, or any time-sensitive query.

include_answer.description: Add an AI-synthesized answer based on the search results (adds 5 credits).

freshness.description: Filter by recency: "day", "week", "month", "year", or a range "YYYY-MM-DD:YYYY-MM-DD".

include_domains.description: Only include results from these domains (max 10).

aiMetadata.description: Run a web search through Sofya for a natural-language query and return extracted page content (not just snippets), optionally with an AI-synthesized answer. Narrow scope with a general vs. news topic, a recency window, result count, and domain include/exclude lists. Use to look up current or external information from the web. Read-only and idempotent: the same query returns equivalent results, though live web data may shift over time.

fetch.name: fetch
fetch.description: Fetch URLs and return clean markdown. Supports web pages, PDFs, and documents.

include_raw_html.description: Also include the raw HTML source in each result (null for non-HTML content such as PDFs).

aiMetadata.description: Fetch one or more URLs and return their content as clean markdown (also supports PDFs and documents). Use when you already have exact URLs (e.g. from a prior search) and need their full text rather than running a new query. Costs 1 credit per URL, up to 10 URLs; failed URLs are not charged. Read-only and idempotent.

extract.name: extract
extract.description: Use AI to pull specific data from a webpage — pricing, specs, contacts, and more.

url.description: The URL to extract information from.

prompt.description: What information to extract (e.g. "list all pricing tiers with features").

aiMetadata.description: Fetch a single web page and use AI to extract specific information described by a prompt (e.g. pricing tiers, specs, author and date), returning targeted text rather than the full page. If the page has no usable text, the response reports low content instead of fabricating an answer. Costs 5 credits. Read-only and idempotent.

research.name: research
research.description: Research any topic — searches up to 30 sources and synthesizes a cited report.

topic.description: Use "news" to prioritize recent news articles.

max_sources.description: Maximum number of sources to use (5-30).

freshness.description: Filter by recency: "day", "week", "month", "year", or a range "YYYY-MM-DD:YYYY-MM-DD".

aiMetadata.description: Perform comprehensive research on a topic: Sofya decomposes the query into sub-queries, searches and reads multiple sources in parallel, then synthesizes a structured report with citations. Best for open-ended or comparative questions that need coverage from many angles; for simple lookups use Search instead. Costs 25 credits. Not idempotent: it selects sources and synthesizes a report at request time, so repeated calls with the same query can differ.

custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
